summary_en: Juroku Financial Group authorized the acquisition of up to 10 million shares (0.9% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum total of 9.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from December 2024 to March 2025.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Juroku Financial Group's Board of Directors resolved to acquire treasury shares as a measure to enhance shareholder returns and support sustainable growth and mid-to-long-term enterprise value improvement for the Group. The company will purchase up to 10 million ordinary shares for a maximum total of 9.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between December 2024 and March 2025. The maximum purchase represents approximately 0.9 percent of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.

As of September 2024, the company held 45 million treasury shares. Including the shares from this acquisition, the cumulative treasury share acquisitions since the company's establishment in June 1995 will total 110 million shares, equivalent to 5.0 percent of total issued shares. The company maintains a basic policy of improving financial soundness while continuing stable dividend distributions, and determines the content of shareholder returns by comprehensively considering the operating environment and profit levels. Treasury share acquisitions are executed flexibly and opportunistically in line with this policy.
